definition.en: Earth's rocky outer layer. Its thickness varies from place to place.
definition.zh: 地球最外面的岩石层，各处厚度不同。

definition.en: The mostly solid rock between the crust and core. It can slowly change shape over very long times.
definition.zh: 地壳与地核之间的岩石，大部分是固态，能在漫长时间内缓慢变形。

definition.en: The crust and rigid uppermost mantle together. This shell is divided into moving plates.
definition.zh: 地壳和刚性的最上部地幔合成的整体，分成移动的板块。

definition.en: A moving block of lithosphere. One plate can include both continental and oceanic parts.
definition.zh: 移动的岩石圈块体，可同时包括大陆和海洋部分。

definition.en: The region of solid metal at the centre of Earth.
definition.zh: 位于地球中心的固态金属区域。

definition.en: The region of liquid metal surrounding the inner core.
definition.zh: 包围内核的液态金属区域。

definition.en: Molten rock material below ground. It can also contain crystals and dissolved gas.
definition.zh: 地下的熔融岩石物质，也可以含晶体和溶解气体。

definition.en: Molten rock that has erupted onto the surface.
definition.zh: 已经喷出到地表的熔融岩石。

definition.en: The sinking of one tectonic plate beneath another.
definition.zh: 一块板块向另一块板块下方下降的过程。

definition.en: An opening where volcanic gas, fragments or lava reach the surface or atmosphere.
definition.zh: 火山气体、碎屑或熔岩到达地表或大气的开口。

definition.en: A fracture surface along which rocks can move past each other.
definition.zh: 岩体能沿着相对移动的破裂面。

definition.en: The place inside Earth where an earthquake rupture starts.
definition.zh: 地球内部一次地震破裂开始的位置。

definition.en: The point on the surface directly above the focus.
definition.zh: 震源在地表正上方的位置。

definition.en: A seismic wave in which material vibrates back and forth along the direction the wave travels.
definition.zh: 物质沿波传播方向来回振动的地震波。

definition.en: A seismic wave in which material vibrates at right angles to the travel direction. It cannot pass directly through the liquid outer core.
definition.zh: 物质振动方向与波传播方向成直角的地震波，不能直接穿过液态外核。

definition.en: A series of long waves caused by a large, sudden movement of water. It is unrelated to tides.
definition.zh: 大量水体突然移动产生的一系列长波，与潮汐无关。
